'''New Drev'starn''' was a settlement that was destroyed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Raygus Mol]], an officer of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
